stated: app(cons(x, xs), ys) = cons(x, app(xs, ys))

tests.goal: code(imp(rain, wet)) = cons(four, cons(one, cons(two, nil)))
code(neg(imp(rain, neg(wet)))) = cons(three, cons(four, cons(one, cons(three, cons(two, nil)))))

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

t.zh: <level-ref to="u-halt"></level-ref>里，程序可以读程序。这几关讲另一件事：算术可以谈论证明。哥德尔在 1931 年分六步做到这一点；前三步用化简算，后三步在证明板上证。
t.en: In <level-ref to="u-halt"></level-ref>, programs read programs. These levels show something else: arithmetic can speak of proofs. Gödel did it in 1931 in six steps; the first three are worked out with Simp, the last three proved on the board.

t.zh: 第一步是<wiki-ref to="goedel-coding"></wiki-ref>：每个符号对应一个数，下雨是 1，地湿是 2，¬ 是 3，→ 是 4。一句话从左往右写成一串数，→ 写在两边之前，不需要括号。⌜A⌝ 是句子 A 的编码，由四条定义算出。
t.en: The first step is <wiki-ref to="goedel-coding"></wiki-ref>: each symbol stands for a number, it rains 1, the ground is wet 2, ¬ 3, → 4. A sentence is written left to right as a list of numbers, with → in front of its two sides, so no brackets are needed. ⌜A⌝ is the code of the sentence A, worked out by four definitions.

after.zh: 一串数还能并成一个数（哥德尔把每一位放进一个质数的指数：2^a·3^b·5^c…）。关于句子的事，于是成了关于数的事。
after.en: A list of numbers can be packed into one number (Gödel put each place in the exponent of a prime: 2^a·3^b·5^c …). Facts about sentences thus become facts about numbers.
